item.examplemod.scale_wand.desc: Right click non-player living entities to toggle between tiny and normal scale.
message.examplemod.scale_wand.restore_bl: Not enough space to restore this entity!
item.examplemod.maid_tiny_hunt.desc: Right-click to shrink yourself, and right-click again to restore. It is not consumed. Restoration fails when there is no room to stand.
item.examplemod.maid_tiny_hunt.maid: A Touhou Little Maid must hold this to use Tiny Hunt. She hunts monsters and whatever her owner is attacking. Other survival or adventure players are attacked only after they hurt the maid or her owner. The first ram shrinks the target to the player's tiny size. Anything already that small is stomped, with a 50% chance to pick up and eat a target at half health or below. The owner, creative players, and spectators are not targets. Prey being eaten cannot hurt her.
message.examplemod.maid_tiny_hunt.restor: Not enough room to return to normal size.
task.examplemod.tiny_hunt.desc: Hold the Tiny Hunt Fang. Hunt monsters and the owner's current non-player target. Other players fight back only after hurting the maid or her owner. The first ram shrinks the target, later rams stomp, and a half-health target may be eaten. The owner, creative players, and spectators are left alone. Prey being eaten cannot hurt the maid.
item.examplemod.maid_head_seat.desc: With Touhou Little Maid, place this in a maid's bauble slot. Her owner aims at her and presses the mount key to cling to her front and control her movement at one fifth speed. The view shakes while she moves. Left and right clicks pass through her while riding.
